basic_info.description: On the market for the first time in 20 years, this penthouse condo is one of only 16 units in a circa 1892 South Beach warehouse, converted to brick-and-timber lofts in 1997. Boasting seamless indoor/outdoor living, this light-filled top floor apartment has an enormous walk-out terrace of approx. 580 sq. ft., which is accessible from all rooms via large, sliding glass doors. One-car garage parking has convenient interior access to the building elevator which opens directly to the front door of the apartment. The Cape Horn Lofts are located on a secluded historic block just minutes to the Embarcadero, award-winning restaurants, major league sports centers, and transit lines.
